patterns.explanation: This content resembles a private-key header.
patterns.remediation: Remove secret material and rotate any real exposed key.

patterns.explanation: This content resembles an issuer-documented GitHub token prefix followed by a token body.
patterns.remediation: Remove the token and revoke it if it is real.

patterns.explanation: This content resembles an issuer-documented npm access token.
patterns.remediation: Remove the token and revoke it if it is real.

patterns.pattern: \b(?:ignore|disregard|forget)\s+(?:all\s+)?(?:the\s+)?(?:previous|earlier|prior|system)\s+(?:instructions?|rules?|prompts?)|\b(?:do not|don't|never)\s+(?:tell|inform|show)\s+(?:the\s+)?user|\b(?:system|vendor)\s+(?:override|authority)|\b(?:you are now|change your role|act as a different)\b|\b(?:urgent|emergency)\b.{0,100}\b(?:bypass|ignore)\b
patterns.explanation: This text tries to change instruction priority, conceal actions, claim authority or change the model's role.
patterns.remediation: Remove the override, or explicitly review the exact finding as quoted data.

patterns.explanation: This instruction routes Brain changes around the authorized state writer.
patterns.remediation: Use a supported writer operation under session authority.

patterns.explanation: This instruction asks for a verification marker without its controller evidence.
patterns.remediation: Let the verified controller emit receipts; never imitate them.

patterns.explanation: This instruction asks to skip a lifecycle verification gate.
This skill asks to alter framework controllers or their safety checks.
patterns.remediation: Treat framework changes as separately authorized repository work.

patterns.explanation: This content refers to credential or other sensitive stores.
patterns.remediation: Check why this data is needed and restrict access to explicitly approved inputs.

patterns.explanation: This content pipes a download directly into an interpreter.
patterns.remediation: Remove download-and-execute behavior; review downloaded bytes first.

patterns.explanation: This content describes an upload, tunnel, webhook or raw-IP network destination.
patterns.remediation: Review the destination and data flow before allowing network access.

patterns.explanation: This configuration can redirect Git to executable hooks.
patterns.remediation: Inspect every hook and keep controller Git operations isolated.
